texts.greeting: Hello! I take simple orders. Send /order to start, /cancel to stop.
texts.ask_item: What would you like to order? (name or article)
texts.ask_contact: Your phone or other contact for confirmation:
texts.ask_comment: Any comment (size, colour, delivery)? Write '-' if none.
texts.ask_photo: You can send a photo (for example a screenshot of the item) or write '-' to skip.
texts.need_text: Please answer with text. Send /cancel to stop.
texts.bad_quantity: Please send a whole number from 1 to 9999.
texts.done: Thank you! Your order {order_id} is recorded. We will contact you.
texts.save_failed: Sorry, the order could not be saved right now. Please send your last answer again in a minute.
